description: This file defines an interface 'HttpPushConfig' which specifies configuration settings for an HTTP push connection, including methods to retrieve maximum queue size and HTTP proxy configuration, along with an enumeration 'ConfigValue' for known configuration paths and default values.

classes.name: HttpPushConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for an HTTP push connection, including buffer size and proxy configuration.

classes.name: HttpPushConfig.ConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration defining known configuration keys and their default values for HttpPushConfig.

methods.name: getMaxQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of messages buffered at the publisher actor before dropping them.

methods.name: getHttpProxyConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the HTTP proxy for all outgoing requests.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with the configuration key.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path expression for the configuration key.
